title: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and ABAP Platform does not perform necessary authorization… (CVE-2026-76965)
description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and ABAP Platform contain a vulnerability where necessary authorization checks are not performed for certain internal functionality. This flaw allows an attacker with low privileges to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the host. Exploitation can severely impact confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
